previous_statement: Because ||T||<=1/3<1, the norm-convergent Neumann series sum_{k>=0}(-T)^k is the two-sided inverse of I_Y+T, and ||(I_Y+T)^{-1}||<=1/(1-||T||)<=3/2.
new_statement: For either special corner at every fixed n, the target Y is Banach. Hence B(Y) is Banach, and ||T||<=1/3<1 makes the Neumann series sum_{k>=0}(-T)^k converge in B(Y) to the two-sided inverse of I_Y+T, with ||(I_Y+T)^{-1}||<=1/(1-||T||)<=3/2.
